import requests

def get_transcripts(gene_id):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    r = requests.get(url).json()
    # Let's search nuccore for RefSeq mRNA
    esearch = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=nuccore&term={gene_id}[Gene+ID]+AND+srcdb_refseq[PROP]+AND+biomol_mrna[PROP]&retmode=json"
    res = requests.get(esearch).json()
    id_list = res.get('esearchresult', {}).get('idlist', [])
    print(f"RefSeq mRNA IDs for gene {gene_id}:", id_list)
    if id_list:
        summary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=nuccore&id={','.join(id_list)}&retmode=json"
        sres = requests.get(summary_url).json()
        for nid in id_list:
            item = sres.get('result', {}).get(nid, {})
            caption = item.get('caption')
            title = item.get('title')
            slen = item.get('slen')
            print(f"  {caption}: {slen} nt, {title}")
